profile.headline: Software Developer

positions.title: Associate Research Analyst - Data Science Division
Graduate Capstone Researcher
positions.description:
• Applied topic modeling across education research papers to explore underlying structural differences.
• Communicated findings with client on a weekly basis through visualizations and presentations.
• Collected and cleaned text data from 100+ educational intervention studies.
• Utilized Scrum workflow to organize tasks and solve problems as a team.

positions.title: Resident Advisor
positions.description:
• Mediate and provide resolutions for residents with issues and complaints with roommates and other students.
• Respond to crisis situations maintaining campus crisis protocols, and document incidents accordingly.

positions.title: Advanced Software Development Methods Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Managed lab attendance and communicated lab expectations as a head teaching assistant for one semester.
• Mentored five teams of students as they build websites over the semester.
• Solved technical difficulties with Django, Git, and Heroku during office hours.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with Data Science Intern to download and parse public dumps of Wikipedia data. 
•	Designed and implemented search interface for Wikipedia data using React, Node.js, and internal API to be packaged for a company demo.
•       Presented a live demo of navigation interface to one of the co-founders, the CEO, and 18 other Lucidworks team members.

positions.title: Wireframe & Source Program Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Teach basic React, JavaScript, Git, HTML/CSS, and data fetching to students with no prior coding experience. 
•	Hold weekly office hours and guide students through weekly coding challenges.
•	Collaborate with program leader to design lessons and projects for students.

positions.title: Cloud Operations Intern
positions.description:
•	Updated and created 300+ test scripts to create more efficient customer database testing for project accounting software package Costpoint.
•	Critiqued test automation tool UI for more intuitive redesign.

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Engage in activities with seniors at Charlottesville Health and Rehab Center.
•	Dedicate one hour per week to the program.
